name: codegraph.index
description: Build or refresh the current repository's local structural code graph with Graphify. Use this before graph queries when no ready index exists.

name: codegraph.query
description: Retrieve a compact multi-hop subgraph for a codebase question with typed edges, confidence, and file/line provenance.

query.description: Question or concept to retrieve from the code graph.

mode.description: Retrieval mode. Hybrid is the default.

maxNodes.description: Maximum nodes to return, up to 1000.

name: codegraph.path
description: Find the shortest structural path between two code symbols or concepts.

source.description: Source symbol label or node id.

target.description: Target symbol label or node id.

name: codegraph.prepare_graphrag
description: Prepare the current structural graph as GraphRAG entity, relationship, and text-unit datasets. This is the optional second stage for global and multi-hop reasoning.

name: codegraph.status
description: Get freshness, version, node counts, Graphify version, and GraphRAG preparation status for the current project.
